title: 一天从一碗面开始
logline: 清晨面馆后厨，老板从揉面、下面到端面给第一位客人，展现一天由一碗热面开启的温暖日常。

shots.narrationZh: 晨光里，面团在掌心揉醒
shots.narrationEn: In the morning light, the dough is kneaded awake in the palm.
shots.visual: Vertical shot: close-up of a noodle shop owner's hands kneading dough on a floured wooden board in the bright kitchen, morning sunlight streaming through the window.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气温和舒展，语速偏缓，重音落在「揉醒」，气息轻缓带暖意，贴合清晨醒神的松弛感

shots.narrationZh: 沸水翻滚，白汽裹着面香
shots.narrationEn: Boiling water rolls, white steam wraps around the noodle aroma.
shots.visual: Vertical shot: the owner lowering a bundle of fresh noodles into a rolling pot of boiling water in the kitchen, thick steam rising instantly.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气鲜活带劲，语速稍快，重音落在「面香」，气息上扬带热感，传递出沸腾的烟火气

shots.narrationZh: 热气升起，一天就开始了
shots.narrationEn: When steam rises, a brand new day begins.
shots.visual: Vertical shot: the owner carrying a steaming bowl of noodles to the first customer by the shop window, the customer smiling in return, early morning street view in the background.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气舒展满足，语速放缓，重音落在「开始了」，气息沉稳带暖意，收尾稍作停顿，传递新一天的踏实感
